findings.summary: billable_hours subtracts two datetimes sharing the same ZoneInfo, so Python ignores UTC offsets and uses wall-clock difference, producing wrong durations (overcharge or undercharge) for sessions spanning a DST change; convert both to UTC before subtracting.

judge.reason: Same cause: same-tzinfo aware datetimes subtract by wall clock, ignoring DST offset; fix by converting to UTC.

findings.label: hit
